title: Ron ve Rubi Hırçın Yanardağ
author: Fatih Cem Gülbent
description: Things are getting messy in Puzzle Land Bulbulya! The violent volcano is waking up, and the puzzles must be solved before the lava engulfs everything! Rubi, the country's smartest parrot, and Ron, the puzzle expert, are counting on your help to find the clues.
english_title: Ron and Rubi The Violent Volcano
